app.title: Soundscape Annotation Atelier
app.subtitle: Annotation tool for soundscape, field recording and electroacoustic composition.

welcome.title: Start by loading an audio file
welcome.subtitle: Drop an audio file above, or use the header button. Supported formats: WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A.
features: Controlled vocabulary: Schaeffer, Smalley, Schafer, Krause, Chion
Time markers with drag and resize on the waveform
JSON export compatible with the soundscape-audio-analysis toolkit
Local persistence with IndexedDB, no server upload
Bilingual IT/EN, installable as a PWA

workbench.noSelection: No selection: click and drag on the waveform

panel.noAnnotations: No annotations yet, select a time range on the waveform and choose a term.
panel.noStructure: No structural sections yet, select a time range on the waveform and give the section a label.
panel.applyHint: First select a time range on the waveform

structure.title: Structural sections
structure.subtitle: Free annotations for macroform and interpretive notes. Kept separate from controlled annotations.
